note: Gunnison County says it does not zone (land use change permits set uses without zone districts). City of Gunnison publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (Exhibit A Zoning Map); its Shapefiles section lists no documents and no ArcGIS service was found. Town of Crested Butte and Town of Mt. Crested Butte publish zoning maps on their websites, which returned 403 or no service links; ArcGIS search found no official zoning feature service for any of them. Third-party copies (zoneomics, crestedbuttecollection) are not official.
